activity.notes: Phibunsongkhram entered office while the state was still officially Siam. ATLAS splits the same continuous premiership at the 24 June 1939 country-name change.

sources.title: Plaek Phibunsongkhram
sources.citation_text: The office chronology gives Phibunsongkhram's prime-ministerial terms as 16 December 1938–1 August 1944 and 8 April 1948–16 September 1957.

sources.title: Siam/Thailand name changes — UNESCO Siam Society minutes
sources.citation_text: The archival nomination records the 24 June 1939 change from Siam to Thailand and notes the postwar reversion to Siam until 1949.

sources.title: Thailand — United Nations
sources.citation_text: The United Nations records that Siam informed the Secretary-General of the change back to Thailand on 11 May 1949.
